response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC, observstation LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories that appear in the telescopes table are counted, so observatories with no telescopes are excluded. The average share is therefore 1 divided by the number of those observatories.
Ties in the difference are broken alphabetically by observatory name.
